name: CM Solutions, Inc.
old_description: CM Solutions is an innovative Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider that focuses on delivering complete end-to-end manufacturing capabilities with the latest technological solutions for companies.
about:
CM Solutions, Inc. was founded in 2002 in Corinth, Mississippi, as a privately owned contract manufacturer serving all electronics market segments. The company was established by Mike, Ron, Jack, and Tommy, who brought decades of combined experience in OEM and contract manufacturing both domestically and abroad. The founders remain actively involved in daily operations, maintaining a hands-on approach with customers.

The firm provides end-to-end electronic manufacturing services (EMS), including build-to-order (BTO), configure-to-order (CTO), and direct-ship programs that integrate seamlessly into customer supply chains. Over its history, CM Solutions has expanded its facility three times, growing to five production lines equipped with selective soldering, automatic optical inspection (AOI), multiple in-circuit test platforms, a DEK Horizon SMT printer, a Faraday cage for RF circuitry, and a dedicated conformal coating room. The company supports low-, medium-, and high-volume production with lead-free (RoHS-compliant) processes.

CM Solutions serves a range of industries, including automotive, medical, military, and general OEM markets. Its customer base spans domestic and international clients seeking customized manufacturing solutions for electronic assemblies. The company’s quality system aligns with IPC-A-610 Classes 1–3 and J-STD-001 standards, enabling it to meet the stringent requirements of regulated sectors.

The business was built on a customer-focused philosophy, emphasizing engineering capabilities, dedication to specific end markets, and technology advantages. With over 100 years of combined industry experience among its leadership, CM Solutions positions itself as a high-performance, cost-effective partner that prioritizes continuous improvement and on-time delivery.
